newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat sharply higher on flood concerns - trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat sharply higher on flood concerns - trade.

text.p: CBOT soft red winter wheat futures shot higher early Monday in response to concerns over flooding in spring wheat areas and commission house buying in the CBOT wheat pit, traders said.
Severe flooding in the Northern U.S. Plains could mean that much of the spring wheat acreage is abandoned, traders said.
In early trade, Refco bought 1.0 million bushels July and L.B. Stern bought 500,000 July, traders said.
AT 0951 CDT, wheat was five to 15-1/4 cents per bushel higher, with July up 13 at $4.57.
